badge_component.reuse_rationale: Directly supports semantic color variants (green, yellow, purple, blue, red, gray) aligning with existing ClaimList epistemic badges.

button_component.reuse_rationale: Supports success, danger, ghost variants, loading spinners, and disabled states without custom button CSS.

toast_notification.reuse_rationale: Consistent toast notification system with fallback for isolated test environments.

api_client.reuse_rationale: Reuses existing pythonApi Axios client with baseUrl, timeout, and response error formatting.

evidence_navigation.reuse_rationale: Reuses onTraceEvidence callback to navigate Workbench directly to selected evidence in EvidenceAnalysisPanel.
